adds.title: SB39 - transgender athlete ban
adds.summary: On June 7, 2023 Missouri Governor Mike Parson signed S.B. 39 requiring all private and public schools through college to require students to participate on sports teams according to sex assigned at birth, and on the same day signed S.B. 49 effective August 28, 2023 banning gender-affirming treatments including puberty blockers for youth until August 2027 with loss of license for violating providers while allowing youth already receiving such care to continue.
